title: Sparsity-driven emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.32153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks can learn multiple tasks, but how learning organizes shared computation into specialized and reusable components remains poorly understood. In this work, we show that sparsity inducing regularization promotes functional modularity in multitask networks without predefined module boundaries. Using functional profiling in multilayer perceptrons and a lightweight transformer, we identified compact, task-selective subnetworks, termed functional tokens. Across rule-based task families, selectively retaining these tokens preserves their associated functions while reducing performance on other tasks. Such specialization develops preferentially in deeper layers during training, while earlier layers retain shared computation. Regularization strength and form shape module compactness and specialization, while task weighting alters functional allocation. translated_title: 稀疏性驱动的多任务神经网络功能模块化的涌现
translated_abstract: 神经网络能够学习多个任务，但学习过程如何将共享计算组织成专门化且可复用的组件，目前仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们证明稀疏性诱导的正则化能够在无需预定义模块边界的情况下，促进多任务网络中功能模块化的形成。通过在多层感知机和轻量级transformer中进行功能剖析，我们识别出了紧凑的、具有任务选择性的子网络，并将其命名为“功能token”（functional tokens）。在基于规则的任务族中，选择性地保留这些token可以维持其对应的功能，同时降低其他任务的表现。这种专门化在训练过程中优先在较深层中发展，而较浅的层则保留共享计算。正则化的强度与形式会塑造模块的紧凑性和专门化程度，而任务权重的设置则会改变功能的分配方式。此外，提取出的功能token还可以通过替代路径进行重组……
tldr: 稀疏性正则化无需预定义模块边界即可促使多任务神经网络自发涌现功能模块化，形成可在深层选择性保留、重组的紧凑“功能token”子网络。
en_tdlr: Sparsity-inducing regularization drives the emergence of functional modularity in multitask neural networks without predefined module boundaries, yielding compact, task-selective "functional tokens" that develop preferentially in deeper layers and can be selectively retained or recombined.
